About

A designer who likes the messy middle.

I came to design through artificial intelligence and software development. That path taught me to ask what a system actually needs before deciding what it should show — and to treat craft as something that has to survive build.

Chicago, IL · Open to UI/UX design roles

01 — The short version

Working on forensic tools taught me how much clarity matters when the stakes are high. Studying AI taught me to question what a product is really optimising for. Now I design digital products end to end — research, structure, interface and prototype — and I like the part where the brief is still vague.

I care about interfaces that are calm, legible and honest. I care about the states nobody screenshots: empty, loading, error, first-time. And I care about shipping, because a design that can't be built isn't finished.

I'm currently finishing an M.S. in Artificial Intelligence at DePaul University and looking for a full-time product design role where research and craft are treated as part of the job.
